Report Description/// NEEC INCIDENT NOTIFICATION: TRAIN DERAILMENT WITH POTASH LAND SPILL | CN RAIL | CHAPPLE, ON /// CALLER REPORTS OF A SPILL OF AN UNKNOWN VOLUME OF SOLID FERTILIZER (POTASH, MONO-AMMONIUM PHOSPHATE) FROM 14 RAIL CARS THAT HAVE DERAILED IN CHAPPLE (FORT FRANCES SUBDIVISION, WEST OF THE TOWN OF EMO). THE SPILL OCCURRED AS A RESULT OF A TRAIN DERAILMENT ON MILE POINT 111(WHERE THE RAIL CROSSES BRIGHAM ROAD SOUTH). THE RAIL CARS ARE ON THEIR SIDE. CALLER INDICATES THAT THE FERTILIZER HAS SPILLED OUT OF THE TOP OF THE HOPPER BUT MOST OF THE POTASH IS CONTAINED IN THE CARS. THE DERAILMENT SITE IS 170 M NORTH OF THE RAINY RIVER BUT CALLER IS CONFIDENT THAT NONE OF THE MATERIAL HAS IMPACTED AND WILL NOT IMPACTED THE RAINY RIVER. THE CURRENT GROUND CONDITION IS FROZEN. THERE IS NO RISK TO THE LOCAL COMMUNITY AS IT IS NOT A LIQUID OR AIR-RELATED SPILL AND THE SPILLED MATERIAL IS NON-REGULATED (NO UN #S). CALLER INDICATES THAT HE IS HEADING TO THE SITE ALONG WITH KGS CONSULTING TO ASSESS THE DAMAGE AND SHOULD BE THERE AT APPROXIMATELY 14:00 CST (OR 15:00 EST) AS THEY ARE OUT OF WINNIPEG. THEY HAVE ALSO RETAINED A CONTRACTOR WILDCAR SECURE. THEY ARE BRINGING IN MACHINERY TO MOVE THE CARS AND TO CONSOLIDATE AND SALVAGE THE POTASH. EXCAVATORS ARE ALSO BEING BROUGHT ON-SCENE. REMOVING THE DERAILED CARS AS WELL AS THE POTASH WILL TAKE UP TO 2 WEEKS OF WORK. CALLER WILL CONTACT SAC BY THE END OF THE DAY WITH AN UPDATE BUT CAN ALSO BE CONTACTED IF FURTHER INFORMATION IS NEEDED. 10:26 SAC (JC) TO TRANSPORTATION SAFETY BOARD OF CANADA BRIEFED. CN RAIL HAS ALSO NOTIFIED THEM. THE TSB SAFETY INSPECTOR WILL ASSESS THE INCIDENT TO SEE IF THEY NEED TO ARRIVE ON-SITE. 10:31 SAC (JC) TO ENVIRONMENT CANADA (1-866-283-2333). BRIEFED. EMAILED REPORT TO THE TRANSPORTATION SAFETY BOARD AND ENVIRONMENT CANADA 14 CARS ARE REPORTED TO BE DERAILED THE RAIL CAR NUMBERS AND TRAIN SYMBOL INVOLVED ARE UNKNOWN.

REPORT DATE: 07-05-2025 REPORT TIME: 2215 UTC REGION: GULF OF AMERICA SUB REGION: N/A AREA/BLOCK: MISSISSIPPI CANYON 20 IMAGE DATE: 07-05-2025 IMAGE TIME: 1626 UTC DATA SOURCE: LANDSAT8 MODE: MULTISPECTRAL RESOLUTION: 30 METER LOCATION: 28°56"16" N/88°58"14" W AREA: 0.62 SQUARE KILOMETERS CONFIDENCE: HIGH REPORT MAP/GIS FILES: HTTPS://WWW.OSPO.NOAA.GOV/PRODUCTS/OCEAN/MARINEPOLLUTION/ REMARKS: POSSIBLE OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. THE POSSIBLE OIL APPEARED TO BE EMANATING FROM THE DESTROYED TAYLOR ENERGY PLATFORM. IT EXTENDED APPROXIMATELY 4.82 NMI TO THE SSW FROM THE SITE AND MEASURED 0.09 NMI AT ITS GREATEST WIDTH. THE SLICK APPEARED DARK IN COLOR WITH SILVERY/WHITE SHIMMER TO PART OF THE ANOMALY. WINDS AT THE TIME OF THE IMAGE WERE 9 KNOTS FROM THE NORTH AND ALIGNED WELL WITH THE ORIENTATION OF THE ANOMALY. CONFIDENCE WAS DETERMINED TO BE HIGH GIVEN THAT THE TAYLOR PLATFORM IS A REPEAT LEAK SOURCE AND VISIBLE CHROMATIC CHARACTERISTICS. properties.content:

Nearest City: Pewaukee, WI

Material: OIL, FUEL: NO. 2-D
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: DONS GRADING SERVICE
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 25 gallons
/////WEB REPORT/// A TRUCK OWNED BY DON'S GRADING SERVICE, A CONTRACTOR OF WISCONSIN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY, EXPERIENCED A LEAK IN ITS DIESEL FUEL TANK WHILE PARKED AT WISCONSIN ELECTRIC'S PEWAUKEE STORES FACILITY LOCATED IN PEWAUKEE, WI. APPROXIMATELY 20-25 GAL. OF DIESEL FUEL SPILLED ON AN ASPHALT PARKING AREA AT THE PRIVATE FACILITY, THEN FLOWED TO A STORMWATER DRAIN BEFORE EXITING THE PROPERTY AND FLOWING INTO AN ADJACENT DITCH CONTAINING WATER. AN ESTIMATED 5-10 GAL. OF DIESEL FUEL WAS ESTIMATED TO HAVE REACHED THE DITCH AND WATER, AS ESTIMATED BY THE SPILL RESPONSE CONTRACTOR. A SPILL RESPONSE CONTRACTOR WAS USED TO REMOVE THE WATER AND DIESEL FUEL USING A VAC TRUCK. ABSORBANT PADS AND BOOMS WERE ALSO INSTALLED. DIESEL FUEL HAD IMPACTED APPROXIMATELY 20-25 FEET OF THE DITCH. THE WISCONSIN DEPT. OF NATURAL RESOURCES WAS NOTIFIED AND CONFIRMED THE REMOVAL APPROACH TAKEN BY THE SPILL CONTRACTOR.
